name: audiogram-maker
description: Turn a podcast or audio clip into a short video for social posts: an animated waveform, the cover image, title and subtitle, a progress bar and burned-in captions. Pick the audio, optionally a cover image and captions (SRT, LRC, or a plain text file with one caption per line, spread over the clip by length). Cut a segment out of a long episode with clip start and end, choose square, vertical or landscape, set the colours and waveform style, and fix caption times in the table; reversed or overlapping times and captions too long to fit are flagged before you render. Exports an MP4 (H.264 + AAC), a poster PNG for the thumbnail and an SRT re-timed to the clip. Runs locally with ffmpeg; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 把播客或音频片段做成发社交平台的短视频：动态波形、封面图、标题和副标题、进度条，以及烧录进画面的字幕。选择音频，可加封面图和字幕（SRT、LRC，或每行一句的纯文本，按长度自动分配到片段里）。用片段开始/结束从一整期节目里截一段，选方形、竖屏或横屏，设置颜色和波形样式，在表格里改字幕时间；时间倒置、字幕重叠、字幕太长放不下都会在渲染前提示。导出 MP4（H.264 + AAC）、做缩略图用的封面 PNG，以及按片段重新计时的 SRT。在本地用 ffmpeg 运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
